page_md:
Most of what decides kratom policy happens in a council chamber on a weeknight, announced a few days ahead. Until now iKratom could only tell you about it if you happened to open the site. Starting today, it comes to you.

## Your daily kratom update, by email

One short email a day with what changed: **new hearings first**, then bills and alerts that need action, news from your state, and the rest of the country. Nothing new means no email.

Prefer weekly, or none at all? [Change it in your settings](/account) in one click. Every email also has a one-click unsubscribe.

## Every hearing, in every state

When a city council or county board puts kratom on its agenda, **every member now gets an alert right away**, wherever they live. A ban that starts in one town is usually copied by the next, and anyone can watch, submit written comment, or email the people who will vote.

Each alert carries the Zoom or livestream link, the sign-up to speak, the agenda, and who decides. [See upcoming hearings](/calendar).

## Read the news here, without the ads

Every story we track opens in iKratom's reader: the full article without the publisher's pop-ups and autoplay, with the bill it is about and the action you can take right beside it. Prefer to listen? Press **Listen** on any article or briefing. [Open today's news](/news).

## Tell us your state (or don't)

Members who set a home state get their state's alerts the moment they break. If you would rather not say, choose that: you will get the most important news from everywhere instead. Your choice stays private. Other members only ever see your @username. [Set it in your settings](/account).

## We were offline October 2 to 5

A single server flooded the site with automated requests and used up our hosting allowance for the month. Nothing was lost and no account data was touched. We have put protections in front of the site so one source cannot do that again.

## Coming next

- **Kratom Academy:** short courses that make you a confident advocate, with a certificate when you finish.
- **Officials briefings:** who decides, how they have voted, and who to contact.
- **Contact a whole council at once**, with templates that fill in your details and ask for anything missing.
- **Groups in the forums**, so local advocates can organize together.

Thank you for showing up for kratom. One email to the right council member at the right time still changes outcomes.
